methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series B → next-stage step-up multiplier (1.9x) to $78M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.rationale: Median across 3 same-sector + same/adjacent-stage peers in Climate & Energy. Range: $700M - $3.0B.

public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in Climate & Bio-Manufacturing

data.narrative:
WeaveGrid, a Series B climate and energy technology company founded by Apoorv Bhargava and John Taggart, has raised $78M to date. The valuation analysis benchmarks against a comp universe of one public company (LNZA) and eight private peers, with particular focus on three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: KoBold Metals ($3.0B Series C), Electric Hydrogen ($1.0B Series C), and Amogy ($700M Series C).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $78M total raised as a valuation proxy, applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B to next-stage advancement, yielding $148M. Peer-median valuation benchmarks WeaveGrid against the three identified comparables, which exhibit a median valuation of $1.0B with a range of $700M to $3.0B. This peer set reflects similar sector exposure and stage proximity, though the range reflects meaningful dispersion in market valuations for frontier-stage climate tech.

The triangulated analysis across these two methods supports a valuation range of $126M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median implied value of $574M. Key uncertainties include the appropriateness of the stage-progression multiplier given WeaveGrid's specific commercial and technical maturity relative to the peer set, and the dispersion observed within the peer comp range itself. The stage and sector context support valuations materially above current raised capital but below peak peer valuations.
